issue.title: artifact-link event store rejects every new link: operation_id reused for different events
issue.description: Discovered by the bob-cli-1z land agent while linking a follow-up task to its proposing bead. Every 'sase artifact link add' in the bob-cli project now fails with: "Error: artifact-link event store is invalid: validation: operation_id `de29d2e25c1cfb4381f223c44d576f8c` was reused for different artifact link events". The failing operation_id is identical across retries and across fresh source/target pairs, and 'sase artifact link list' still reads fine, so the duplicate pair already exists in the stored events (pre-existing corruption, possibly from a retried link write around the 2026-09-07 bob-cli-1u<->bob-cli-1x link) and whole-store validation now blocks all appends. Needs investigation of the artifact-link events in the bead store plus either a data repair (dedupe the colliding events) or a sase fix (tolerate/repair idempotent replays), and ideally a guard so one bad historical pair cannot brick all future link writes.

task_type_fields.impact: No agent in this project can record any new artifact link (bead-to-bead related links, task evidence refs), so /sase_new_task's related-link and retired-umbrella flows are broken until the store is repaired.
task_type_fields.location: bob-cli beads store artifact-link events; validated by sase artifact link add (sase 0.17.1)
task_type_fields.repro: From a bob-cli workspace, run: sase artifact link add bead:bob-cli-20 related bead:bob-cli-1z.5 "why" — fails with the operation_id-reuse validation error; retries and different endpoints fail identically while sase artifact link list succeeds.

evidence.note: Independently reproduced 2026-09-20 by the bob-cli-23 land agent (sase 0.17.1, workspace bob-cli_10). 'sase artifact link add bead:bob-cli-24 related bead:bob-cli-v "..."' failed with the same fixed operation_id de29d2e25c1cfb4381f223c44d576f8c, on a bead pair that has never been linked before, confirming the collision is in the stored history rather than in the new write. Impact here: the /sase_new_task related-link step could not be completed for the new task bob-cli-24, so the relation had to be recorded as free text in a bead note instead. Still failing 10 days after the original report.

payload.close_reason: Stale task bead swept from triage.

evidence.note: Reproduced 2026-09-30 by bob-cli-2r.land on the current workspace. `sase artifact link add bead:bob-cli-2t related bead:bob-cli-2r` and a retry of that same new pair both fail with operation_id de29d2e25c1cfb4381f223c44d576f8c reused for different events. `sase artifact link list bead:bob-cli-2t` still reads and shows no links. The related-link step for new tasks bob-cli-2t and bob-cli-2u could not be written; the proposing-epic relation is recorded in those tasks' creation reasons and in the bob-cli-2r land note instead.

Independently reproduced 2026-10-04 (agent 0wk, sase checkout aeccf84357) with a new, worse impact: 'sase plan propose' on a tale plan whose frontmatter has a 'links:' inlet crashes in publish_plan_artifact_link_inlet -> load_artifact_rows -> assert_healthy with the same fixed operation_id de29d2e25c1cfb4381f223c44d576f8c. The crash happens AFTER move_plan_to_sase has already consumed the scratch file into ~/.sase/plans/YYYYMM/ but BEFORE the pending-handoff marker is written, so the proposal is left half-done: the plan is archived, but there is no approval gate and the runner is not handed off. Workaround: move the archived file back to the scratch path, drop 'links:', and re-propose (the read-derived link pass is best-effort and does not block). Locating the collision: the operation_id appears in exactly two plans-sidecar link-event objects, link-events/v1/6e/6efae635a11ed1b059bcf2570f6dfcb6bbf69a96f4b7d2e92d5df125f60fe26c.json and link-events/v1/51/513bdb2010562a67007a473f61a187bcb41705f6c0e99eb130631f767620c233.json (it also appears in the bob-cli-2w land chat and bead streams bob-cli-1z/21/23/2c/2w). Suggested sase hardening: validate or publish the link inlet before consuming the scratch plan, or roll the archive back on failure.

Reproduced 2026-10-06 from bob-cli_12: 'sase artifact link add bead:bob-cli-4r related file:explicit:471b378efdb4ef479c5ca26e "..."' failed with 'artifact-link event store is invalid: validation: operation_id de29d2e25c1cfb4381f223c44d576f8c was reused for different artifact link events'. Impact: research agents cannot link discovered-bug beads to the report that measured them.

Independent bob-cli-4q landing reproduction: typed related-link attempts for bob-cli-4t -> bob-cli-4n and bob-cli-4u -> bob-cli-4s both fail with fixed operation_id de29d2e25c1cfb4381f223c44d576f8c reused for different artifact-link events. Task creation and notes still work. Record the relations in bead notes and omit a links inlet in the remaining-work tale proposal; no duplicate task.

Independent lead-researcher check 2026-10-07 ~16:50 UTC from bob-cli_11 on master 65501f6: read-only 'sase artifact doctor' exits 1 (Status unhealthy). It reports 'Link event reduction errors: validation: operation_id de29d2e25c1cfb4381f223c44d576f8c was reused for different artifact link events' and 'Link event objects 977 durable / 10482 pending (delta +9505)'. At 16:58 UTC, 'sase artifact link add bead:bob-cli-5i related bead:bob-cli-4j ...' failed with the same error. In the 48h audit window, six newly filed task beads (4t, 4u, 58, 5c, 5g, 5h) also record typed links rejected and kept as free text.
